text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Anatomy of Anxiety: One Formula, Two Levers

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: 焦虑 = 重要性 × 不确定性

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Anxiety = Importance × Uncertainty

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Multiplication, not addition — zero either term and the anxiety goes to zero. Which means two independent places to act

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Lever 1: Lower the uncertainty

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Not eliminate it — raise your tolerance for it

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Break the big question into small ones

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: "What do I do about the next 20 years" is 100% uncertain; "which three things in six months" is not

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Write the worst case down first

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Uncertain bad becomes certain bad. Certain bad is easier to handle than uncertain good

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Control your information intake

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Read about AI once a week on purpose, instead of being shelled by notifications daily

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Practise attention in a relaxed state

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Anxiety narrows vision. Walking and cooking beat doomscrolling for good ideas

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Lever 2: Lower the importance

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: The more subversive one — much of it matters less than you assume

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Work

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Is it the income you fear losing, or the identity? The two have completely different fixes

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Your child's grades

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: When "grades to university to job" is itself breaking, grades lose weight automatically

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Face

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: In an era of structural unemployment, being laid off is a wave, not a verdict on you

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: House prices

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: If you live in it, the price is irrelevant to your day — unless you actually intend to sell

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Audit your anxiety list: does this actually matter, or am I hostage to social inertia?

text.font-family: PingFang SC, Hiragino Sans GB, sans-serif

svg.text: Put one down, and the anxiety drops by one
